provenance.distribution: Local conversion only; game asset redistribution permission not established
provenance.coordinateRule: Godot Y-up, identity axes; meters / CELL_M, then integer bounds translation; Qodot scale already applied in .tscn

materialLosses.CERAMIC: Existing brittle, acid-proof fired tile; source patterns/glazes omitted. Different toughness/melting from original game geometry.
materialLosses.CRYSTAL: Existing self-glowing brittle material; not exact lamp color, volumetric light shader or an electrical circuit. LAMP would require an unsupported power feed.
materialLosses.GLASS: Transparent brittle panel; colored panes and display graphics omitted. Screens are not programmable/electrical devices.
materialLosses.LIMESTONE: Closest existing carbonate behavior for marble; not a separate marble palette. Acid/heat/break behavior is ours, not source script parity.
materialLosses.METAL: Conductive/breakable metal; no source door motion, container contents, grate holes below cell resolution or screen circuitry is invented.
materialLosses.ROCK: Structural substrate; painted facades, grotesque/mossy graphics and animated pattern shaders are not reproduced. No edible/growing mechanic is inferred from a surface picture.
materialLosses.WALL: Untextured collision substrate only; original purpose of material-less faces is ambiguous. Not a fallback for unknown materials.
materialLosses.WATER: Existing liquid; colored/swamp water is not classified as blood/toxic without source mechanic evidence. Surface-only voxel liquid can drain.
materialLosses.WOOD: Burnable/breakable organic substrate; rug fiber and painted doors use existing wood rather than a new cosmetic element.

collision.method: Conservative triangle/cell intersection; generated elements use existing voxel collision and destruction

limitations: Embedded level geometry only: external PackedScene props, actors, and scripts are not executed or expanded.
Surface voxels preserve authored triangles within cell resolution; enclosed interiors are not flood-filled.
Doors and elevators are imported at authored rest transforms, not animated.

Actor source pivots are preserved in sourceAt; fixed X/Z feet require SOLID support and full ordinary body clearance within 3 meters below. Obstructed guards are explicit placementFailures; obstructed targets/spawn disable mission eligibility.
All authored normal exits are retained in extractions; exact bounds take precedence over inscribed cylinder compatibility fields.
NPC types/weapons are destination representations, not original AI parity; unsupported and hell/chaos actors remain in sourceActors inventory.
Source texture names translate to audited physical materials; original texture pixels and shader effects are not copied.
